preconditions.description: The number of strings, n, is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string has length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If no valid ordering exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n strings in valid order.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and all(s1 in s2 for s1, s2 in zip(output_strings, output_strings[1:]))
postconditions.description: For every string in the output order, all preceding strings must be substrings of it.
The output contains exactly the same strings as the input, in some order.
